Before you follow any signal, know exactly what a signal is.
A trading signal is an instruction that tells you where to enter a trade.
For example, on gold it says, "Enter at 4035." That is the Entry.
A signal from someone who protects their reputation also tells you where to place the Stop Loss.
If there is a Stop Loss, they also tell you where the Take Profit is.
To follow a signal, you need three pieces of information: Entry, Stop Loss and Take Profit.
Only after all three arrive do you enter the trade.
